data.name: Escape, Chef Danegade!
data.detailed_description:
Freely type or speak to AI-driven NPCs as you investigate a mysterious restaurant haunted by a deadly killer.

Escape Chef Danegade! is a psychological horror RPG where every conversation can reveal clues, uncover hidden truths, or help you survive. Unlike traditional dialogue trees, players can respond naturally through freeform text or voice interactions.

Explore the restaurant, search for items and food, solve puzzles, and find ways to distract and manipulate the killer long enough to escape alive.

Features

  • Freely type or speak to AI-driven NPCs

  • Freeform conversations beyond traditional dialogue trees

  • Explore and investigate a mysterious restaurant

  • Search for clues, items, and supplies

  • Distract and manipulate a deadly killer

  • Escape-room inspired survival gameplay

  • Retro RPG-style visuals
